name: Nyurba
source:
“Alrighty, everyone—time to pull back.
Unless there’s something unusual to report,
you can save the damage assessments for later.”

Unit: Escort Red, 2nd Squad
Rank: Address

She is a squad leader assigned to defend H.A.Z.E.'s base of operations.

Her appearance is carefree and unrestrained, but she is calculating and sly beneath the surface.

To maximize the effectiveness of her ability, she always acts in tandem with regular troops.
